name: Security Card Games
desc: Train your skills and discuss various security topics.

resources.name: Cornucopia
resources.desc: OWASP® Cornucopia is a threat modeling tool in the form of a card game to assist software development teams identify security requirements in Agile, conventional and formal development processes. It's based on OWASP's Top 10, ASVS/MASVS/MASTG, CAPEC and SAFECode. The card decks) are available both as a Website version and a Mobile version as physical decks that can be bought online or in a digital format at copi.owasp.org.

resources.name: Crypto Go
resources.desc: An educational card game designed to teach up to date

resources.name: Know your risks
resources.desc: Learn what information is safe to share online and understand the risks. Learn about whether to share, not share or be cautious with different pieces of information.

resources.name: Backdoors & Breaches
resources.desc: An incident response card game. It helps you conduct incident response tabletop exercises and learn attack tactics, tools, and methods.

resources.name: Defensomania
resources.desc: An incident response card game for security monitoring and incident response teams to discuss priorities, possible response actions and attack scenarios.

resources.name: Elevation of Privilege (EOP) by Microsoft
resources.desc: A card game based on Microsoft's threat modeling framework "STRIDE" (Spoofing, Tampering etc.). The card deck is available as PDF from Microsoft. Adam Shostack, the author of EoP has also a git repo for EoP.

resources.name: Security Cards
resources.desc: A card game encouraging to think broadly and creatively about computer security threats. Four dimensions are covered: Human Impact, Adversary's Motivations, Adversary's Resources, Adversary's Methods.

resources.name: Cumulus
resources.desc: A threat modeling card game for the clouds which helps you find threats to your DevOps or cloud project and teaches developers a security oriented mindset.

resources.name: Tabletop Security Games & Cards
resources.desc: List of security card games created and maintained by Adam Shostack.

resources.name: Tabletop Simulations to Improve Your Information Security Program
resources.desc: Red Canary's write-up about tabletop exercises for information security programs.

resources.name: Game On: Tabletop Games to Teach Cyber and Information Security Concepts
resources.desc: List of tabletop games to teach cyber and information security concepts.
